attr.title: Circa Infinity
attr.desc: Circa Infinity is a brain-melting circular platformer by Kenny Sun, with a pulse-pounding soundtrack by Jack + Jim Fay.
attr.desc_md: Purchase the game on Steam and place the CircaInfinity.exe into the assets folder.
attr.inst: Purchase the game on [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/390610/Circa_Infinity/) and place the `CircaInfinity.exe` into the `assets` folder.
